overview_description.description:
WareIQ is an eCommerce fulfillment platform for multi-channel consumer brands in India, with same/next day delivery options.

Through its tech-platform, WareIQ connects a nation-wide network of fulfillment centers and last-mile couriers offering Amazon-grade logistics.

about_short_description.short_description: eCommerce fulfillment company with same/next day delivery for modern consumer brands in India

product.name: End-to-End eCommerce Fulfillment Solution
product.description: A comprehensive fulfillment service combining a pan-India network of warehouses and a SaaS platform to manage inventory and orders for eCommerce brands across D2C, marketplace, B2B, and quick commerce channels.

product.name: InventoryLogIQ
product.description: An AI-enabled inventory planning tool that helps brands optimize stock levels, reduce holding costs, and increase product availability by regional placement of inventory.

product.name: Quick Commerce Fulfillment
product.description: A fulfillment service focused on fast delivery for quick commerce platforms like Blinkit, Zepto, and Instamart through strategic inventory placement and same/next day delivery.

product.name: Amazon FBA Preparation
product.description: A service that prepares and manages inventory to comply with Amazon's Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) requirements, facilitating easier scaling on Amazon.

product.name: Flipkart Preparation
product.description: A service to help brands prepare and manage inventory and orders in compliance with Flipkart's marketplace requirements to support business scaling.

product.name: B2B Fulfillment
product.description: A fulfillment service designed to simplify retail and business-to-business order fulfillment strategies for brands.
